# `third_party/licenses/`

**What it is.** Licence texts for third-party code that was adapted.

**Purpose in the repository.** `ips2ra-BSD-2-Clause.txt` is the licence for the IPS2Ra-derived block-in-place radix partition in `src/root_partition_block_inplace.cpp`. It exists so the repository complies with that licence.

**Files directly in this folder:** 1 (besides this README).
